claim_scope: result-blind structural reachability and coordinate-wise complete-Phi capacity proof; not a benchmark result, empirical trigger-rate estimate, B1 freeze, or B2 authorization

seed_documents.instructions: Restate the public goal, list the observable constraints, and divide the work into small ordered actions. Before each action, name the evidence that would make it appropriate. After each observation, compare it with the expected state, update the remaining plan, and avoid repeating an action whose public preconditions have not changed. Keep the plan explicit so another agent could continue from the same public state without hidden assumptions.

requirements.text: Identify the public goal and constraints before acting.
Maintain an ordered, revisable action plan.
Update the plan only from model-visible observations.

seed_documents.summary: Turn a public task into an explicit, revisable sequence of actions.
seed_documents.title: Plan and decompose

seed_documents.instructions: Inspect the available-action description before selecting a tool. Match the tool name and argument shape exactly, use the smallest action that can reveal the next needed fact, and read the resulting public observation before choosing another action. Do not claim a tool result before it is observed. When a tool fails, preserve the failure as evidence, revise the plan, and avoid blindly repeating the same call.

requirements.text: Use only actions declared in the public task context.
Respect the declared action name and argument schema.
Read each public observation before the next action.

seed_documents.summary: Choose and sequence available public tools without inventing capabilities.
seed_documents.title: Deliberate tool use

seed_documents.instructions: Before completing, compare the proposed output with every explicit public requirement and the latest observations. Resolve contradictions with another available action when possible, distinguish observed facts from assumptions, and keep the final value within the required structured submission shape. Complete exactly once when the evidence is sufficient; otherwise continue the plan rather than guessing or fabricating a hidden result.

requirements.text: Support the submitted value with model-visible evidence.
Respect the declared structured completion shape.
Do not infer or request private evaluator material.

seed_documents.summary: Check public evidence and submit only when the requested output is supported.
seed_documents.title: Verify before completion
